error_unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again, and check the manager log if it keeps happening.
error_unreachable: Driver Hub could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
startup_unavailable_body: The management service could not be reached. Running drivers are not affected.
signin_subtitle: Use your Driver Hub operator account.
signin_error_invalid: The username or password is incorrect, or the account is disabled.
signin_error_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
signin_help: Forgot your password? A Driver Hub administrator can set a new one for you.
signin_notice_password_changed: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
reauth_description: Sign in again to continue where you left off. Running drivers are not affected.
password_description: Changing your password signs you out everywhere, including here.
password_first_login: Choose a new password before using Driver Hub. Then sign in again with your new password.
topbar_namespace_title: The Nomad namespace this Hub manages
palette_placeholder: Type a page or an action
overview_description: The site's devices, updates and background work, and what it still needs.
overview_error_title: Site status could not be loaded
overview_attention_admin: Complete the items below before staging drivers.
overview_attention_viewer: An administrator needs to complete the items below before drivers can be staged.
readiness_nomad_no_leader: Reachable, but the cluster has no leader. Nomad cannot schedule drivers.
readiness_nomad_not_configured: No cluster address is configured yet.
readiness_videoipath_configured: Address and driver tokens are configured. Hub does not open a session to check it.
readiness_videoipath_missing: No VideoIPath address or driver tokens are configured yet.
images_description: Hub runs an image service on every eligible Nomad client. Drivers pull their images from the copy on their own machine.
images_problems: Clients where it does not run
images_note: Each copy keeps every image staged at least once, so a driver that Nomad moves to another client starts even while the manager is down. Hub sets this up when the Nomad connection is saved; there is nothing to configure.
images_summary_not_configured: Starts by itself once the Nomad cluster is set up.
images_summary_unavailable: This manager has no image service to start, so drivers cannot get their images. Run Hub from its container image, which includes it.
images_summary_starting: Starting the image service on the Nomad clients…
images_summary_copying: Copying images: {upToDate} of {running} clients hold every image.
images_summary_ready: Running on {running} clients, each holding every image.
images_summary_failing_clients: Clients where the image service cannot start: {count}. Last event: {event}.
images_summary_failing: Hub could not set up the image service: {detail}
readiness_builds_enabled: Admins can build drivers from source on this manager.
readiness_builds_disabled: Off. Published releases can still be deployed. Turn builds on in the Manager settings.
access_admin_note: You can configure the site, manage users and change deployments.
access_viewer_note: You can see everything and preview changes, but an administrator applies them.
hop_requested_running: Hub asked Nomad to run one instance of the driver.
hop_requested_stopped: Hub asked Nomad to run no instance. The deployment and its configuration are kept.
hop_requested_unknown: Nomad could not report what this deployment asks for.
hop_allocation_inactive: No allocation is wanted while the deployment is stopped.
hop_allocation_unplaced: Nomad has not placed the driver on a client yet. The scheduler evaluations show why.
hop_allocation_waiting: Placed on {host}, but not running yet ({status}).
hop_approval: Approval happens in VideoIPath. Hub cannot observe it, so it is never shown as verified.
evidence_connected: The driver's control check reports VideoIPath and the device connected.
evidence_connected_at: The driver's control check reported VideoIPath and the device connected at {time}.
evidence_failed: The driver's control check reports a failure.
evidence_failed_at: The driver's control check reported a failure at {time}.
evidence_stopped: Nothing to check while the deployment is stopped.
evidence_no_control_check: This release declares no control check, so Hub cannot observe control. Check device communication in VideoIPath.
evidence_no_single_current_allocation: There is no single running allocation of the current version to check yet.
evidence_check_unavailable: Nomad could not report the control check just now.
evidence_no_observation: The control check has not reported a result yet.
evidence_stale_observation: The last check result is more than 30 seconds old, so it is not counted.
evidence_check_pending: The control check has not passed or failed yet.
evidence_status_unavailable: Nomad could not report this deployment just now.
evidence_job_unavailable: The Nomad job could not be read.
deployments_no_cluster_admin: Drivers run as jobs on the site's Nomad cluster. Configure its address and token in the Nomad cluster settings.
deployments_no_cluster_viewer: Drivers run as jobs on the site's Nomad cluster, which an administrator has not configured yet.
deployments_empty_body: Each deployment connects one physical device to VideoIPath through a driver. Staging new deployments from the web app arrives with the catalog; until then, use the deployments API described in OPERATIONS.md.
deployments_stale_body: Refreshing failed ({detail}). Hub tries again automatically.
deployments_search_placeholder: Name, node ID, driver or client
deployments_no_match_body: Change the filter or the search text to see more devices.
deployment_error_title: The deployment could not be loaded
deployment_not_found_body: Hub manages no deployment with node ID {nodeId}.
deployment_migration_body: This deployment was staged with the node ID of a driver that runs outside Hub. Stop that driver before you start this one: two drivers with the same node ID take the VideoIPath session from each other.
deployment_status_description: From the requested state to approval, as far as Hub can observe
deployment_no_allocations: Nomad has no allocations for this deployment. It has not been started yet, or Nomad has removed older ones.
deployment_no_history: Nomad retains no versions of this job.
deployment_no_evaluations: Nomad has no evaluations for this job.
deployment_evaluations_note: A completed evaluation means Nomad scheduled the job. It does not show that the driver controls the device.
deployment_configuration_note: Secret values never pass through Hub. The driver reads them from the Nomad Variable nomad/jobs/driverhub-{nodeId}.
configuration_none: No values were entered; the release defaults apply.
configuration_error_unknown_input: is not an input of this version
configuration_error_site_input: is supplied by the site and must be left out
configuration_error_identity: is supplied by Hub and must be left out
placement_summary: Group {group}: {evaluated} clients evaluated, {filtered} filtered out, {exhausted} without capacity.
action_problem_conflict: This deployment changed after you opened this preview. Review its current state before you apply anything.
action_problem_placement: Nomad cannot place the driver on any eligible client.
action_problem_original: Confirm that the original external driver is stopped.
action_problem_configuration: The target version needs configuration this deployment does not have.
action_problem_configuration_next: Choose Change configuration to enter it for this version.
action_problem_uncertain: Hub did not get a definite answer, so the change may have been applied. Reload the deployment and check its state before you try again.
action_problem_not_retained: This version is not downloaded to this Hub. Download it in the catalog first.
preview_description: Nomad plans the change first. Nothing changes until you apply it.
preview_schedulable: Nomad can place the driver now
preview_viewer_note: You can preview changes; an administrator applies them.
consequence_start: Nomad starts one instance on an eligible client. The driver then connects to VideoIPath with this device's node ID; approve new devices in VideoIPath.
consequence_migration_title: This deployment replaces an external driver
consequence_migration_body: Stop the original driver first. Two drivers with the same node ID take the VideoIPath session from each other.
confirm_original_stopped: The original external driver for this device is stopped
confirm_original_stopped_hint: Required for the first start of a migrated device.
consequence_stop_title: VideoIPath loses control of this device
consequence_stop_body: Control and monitoring through this driver stop until it runs again. The deployment, its configuration and its node ID are kept.
consequence_stop_migration: Moving the device back to an external driver? Wait until the allocation has actually stopped before you start the original.
consequence_update: The driver restarts with version {version} and this deployment's current configuration. The current version and configuration are saved, so you can roll back.
consequence_rollback: The driver restarts with version {version} and the configuration saved with it. Changes made on the device itself are not undone.
update_none_body: This Hub has no other retained version of {driver}. Download one in the catalog first.
update_published_body: Download it in the catalog to deploy it here.
update_configuration_note: The update keeps this deployment's configuration and node ID.
notice_accepted_body: Nomad accepted the new desired state. The status below shows when the allocation runs and what the driver reports.
notice_unchanged_body: The deployment already uses this version and this configuration.
rename_description: The name is shown in Driver Hub only. Changing it never restarts the driver.
rename_error_empty: Enter a name, or remove it.
rename_error_control: Remove line breaks and other control characters.
configuration_form_none: This release declares no inputs for the operator.
configuration_field_wrong_type: This value has the wrong type for this input.
configuration_field_secret_reference: Enter the name of a secret, not its value.
configuration_field_unknown_input: This version does not declare this input.
configuration_field_site_input: The site supplies this input; leave it empty.
configuration_field_identity: Hub supplies this input; leave it empty.
configuration_field_unsupported_binding: This release passes the input in a way Hub does not support.
configuration_error_secret_key: Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or underscore.
configuration_hint_secret: The name of a key in the Nomad Variable {variable}, not the secret itself.
configuration_supplied_site_token: A driver token reserved from the site's pool
stage_description: {driver} {version}. Staging creates a stopped deployment; nothing runs until you start it.
stage_form_error: The release's inputs could not be loaded
stage_identity_new_description: Hub assigns a new node ID. Approve the device in VideoIPath once it connects.
stage_identity_replace_description: Keep the node ID the device already has in VideoIPath. Stop the original driver before starting this one.
stage_node_id: Node ID of the external driver
stage_node_id_hint: The lowercase UUID the original driver connects with.
stage_connection_site_description: Recommended. Hub supplies the endpoint and reserves a driver token for this device.
stage_connection_manual: Enter the connection in the configuration below
stage_connection_manual_description: For a driver that connects some other way, or to a different target.
stage_connection_unavailable: No site VideoIPath target is configured, so any connection inputs are entered below.
stage_next_secrets: Create these keys in the Nomad Variable {variable}:
stage_next_start: Start the deployment from its page.
stage_next_approve: Approve the device in VideoIPath once it connects.
stage_error_node_id_format: Enter a lowercase UUID such as 3f2a…-…; the all-zero UUID is not allowed.
stage_problem_configuration: Some of the configuration needs attention.
stage_problem_pool: The site has no unused VideoIPath driver token for another device.
stage_problem_pool_link: Add tokens in the VideoIPath settings
stage_problem_exists: A deployment with this node ID already exists.
stage_problem_site_changed: The site's VideoIPath target changed meanwhile. Preview again.
stage_problem_site_input: Leave the VideoIPath inputs to the site, or choose to enter the connection yourself.
stage_problem_uncertain: Hub did not get a definite answer, so the deployment may have been staged. Trying again is safe: it reuses the same request.
stage_problem_preview_again: The request changed after an unanswered attempt. Preview it again before staging.
stage_possibly_staged_body: An earlier attempt got no answer and may have staged node ID {nodeId}. Check it before staging another device.
update_change_configuration: Change the configuration for this version
update_change_configuration_hint: Start from the current configuration. Inputs the new version no longer declares are dropped.
deployment_staged_body: Start it when the device and its secrets are ready. Nothing runs until then.
operation_interrupted_reason: The manager restarted while this ran. It was not resumed.
activity_unavailable_body: This manager runs downloads and builds only while the request lasts, so there is nothing to follow here.
activity_empty_body: Downloads of published releases and source builds run in the background on the manager. They appear here while they run and after they finish.
activity_interrupted_body: The manager restarted while they ran and does not resume them, because a build may already have had side effects. Check the catalog before starting one again.
activity_footnote: The manager keeps the 50 most recent operations. They run on the manager, so signing out or closing this page does not stop them.
overview_no_attention: No device reports a failure or lacks a status. Control that Hub cannot observe is not counted as verified.
overview_stage_first: Stage the first device from the catalog
overview_no_updates: No device has a newer version available.
overview_no_work: Nothing has been downloaded or built yet.
delete_stop_first_body: A deployment can only be deleted while Nomad is asked to run no instance of it. Stop it, then delete it.
delete_removes: This purges the Nomad job {job} with its version history, and the device name kept by Hub. It cannot be undone.
delete_keeps_secrets: The Nomad Variable {variable} with the device's secrets, if you created one.
delete_keeps_token: The VideoIPath driver token reserved for this device. Remove it from the pool in the VideoIPath settings.
delete_keeps_videoipath: The device in VideoIPath. Remove it there if it is retired.
delete_problem_conflict: The deployment changed after you opened this. Close the dialog, review its current state and try again.
delete_problem_running: The deployment is requested to run. Stop it first.
delete_problem_shared_writers: Hub does not purge Nomad jobs on this site, because other tools also change them. Change that in the Nomad settings, or remove the job in Nomad.
delete_shared_writers_title: Deleting is turned off on this site
delete_shared_writers_body: The Nomad settings say other tools also change Hub's jobs. Hub then never purges a job, because a purge cannot check that the job is unchanged. Remove the job in Nomad instead, or change the setting if Hub is the only writer.
delete_done_body: Remove the Nomad Variable {variable} yourself if you created one for this device.
delete_done_variable_failed: Registration cleanup is pending at {variable}. Check ownership, changed keys and Variable permissions before removing only the old registration key. Retry deletion with the reviewed revision.
release_use_unconfirmed: Usage on another target or an unfinished operation must be reconciled.
deployment_rollout: Nomad rollout for job version {version}: {status}. Device communication is checked separately.
release_error_title: The release could not be loaded
release_not_found_body: Neither this Hub nor the public repository has {driverId} {version}.
release_published_only_body: This release is published upstream. Download it to this Hub to deploy it.
release_inputs_description: What a deployment of this release is configured with
release_input_identity: Supplied by Hub: the device's node ID.
release_input_site: Supplied by the site when the deployment uses its VideoIPath target.
release_control_check: The driver reports control at {path} on port {port}. Hub shows control as verified only from a recent successful check of the current allocation.
release_no_control_check_body: Hub can report whether the driver runs, but not whether it controls the device. Check device communication in VideoIPath.
release_used_by_none: No device is on this version. Devices may still keep it to roll back to.
release_remove_body: This deletes the downloaded archive and the verified image that Nomad clients pull. Hub refuses while a device runs this release or keeps it to roll back to.
release_remove_maintainer_note: A published release can be downloaded again later.
release_remove_customer_note: This is a customer build. Removing it is final; only a new build or import brings it back, under a new version.
release_use_previous: keeps it to roll back to
catalog_build_trust_title: Builds run the driver's own Dockerfile
catalog_build_trust_body: The build daemon executes code from the selected revision. Build only revisions you have reviewed, on a builder suited to that trust level.
catalog_error_driver_format: Use lowercase letters and digits, separated by single hyphens.
catalog_error_version_format: Use a SemVer version such as 1.2.0.
videoipath_token_remove_body: Hub forgets this token, so no new device can reserve it. It stays valid in VideoIPath until you revoke it there.
videoipath_token_remove_deleted: It was reserved for a device whose deployment has been deleted.
videoipath_token_in_use: The token is reserved for a deployment that still exists. Delete that deployment first.
videoipath_token_removed: Token {fingerprint}… was removed from the pool
videoipath_token_revoke: Revoke it in VideoIPath as well; Hub cannot do that.
users_delete_body: The account is removed and all its sessions end. Running drivers are not affected. To only block sign-in for now, disable the account instead.
users_username_hint: Lower-case letters, digits, periods, underscores and hyphens. Sign-in ignores case.
users_role_admin_description: Also applies changes, configures the site and manages accounts.
users_create_description: A local Driver Hub account. There is no self-service sign-up.
users_create_note: Give the person the password through a secure channel. They can change it after signing in.
users_enabled: Allow this account to sign in
users_enabled_hint: Disabling an account ends its sessions at once. Running drivers are not affected.
users_edit_description: Saving ends every session of this account, so the change applies at once.
users_edit_self_description: This is your account. Saving ends your sessions, including this one.
users_edit_self_warning: You will be asked to sign in again after saving.
users_error_username_format: Use 1–64 lower-case letters, digits, periods, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.
users_error_taken: An account with this username already exists.
users_error_last_admin: At least one enabled administrator must remain. Make another account an administrator first.
users_notice_saved: Account {username} was updated and its sessions ended
users_footnote: Hub keeps salted password hashes, never passwords. A forgotten password is reset here by another administrator.
site_error_title: Site settings could not be loaded
site_error_conflict: Someone else changed the site settings meanwhile. The current values are shown again; review them and save once more.
nomad_current_note: Connected means Hub found a leader and could list jobs in the namespace. It does not mean a client can run a driver.
nomad_form_description: Running drivers keep running while you change this.
nomad_address_hint: A host name or IP address uses HTTPS on port 4646. Enter a full URL for another scheme or port.
nomad_token_keep_description: Only possible for the same address and namespace.
nomad_token_keep_unavailable: A saved token is only kept for the same address and namespace.
nomad_token_none_description: For a cluster with ACLs disabled.
nomad_token_field_hint: A token for a namespace dedicated to Driver Hub. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
nomad_target_change_title: This changes the cluster or namespace
nomad_target_change_body: The VideoIPath target is cleared for future deployments, so a VideoIPath credential is never carried to another cluster. Existing jobs keep their saved configuration and keep running.
nomad_submit_note: Hub saves only after it reaches the leader and can list jobs.
nomad_saved: Saved. Hub reached the Nomad leader.
nomad_error_address: Enter a host name, IP address or http(s) URL without a path.
nomad_error_namespace: Use letters, digits, underscores and hyphens.
nomad_error_datacenters: Datacenter names use letters, digits, periods, underscores, hyphens and *.
nomad_error_token: Enter the ACL token, or choose another option.
nomad_plain_http: Send the token over plain HTTP
nomad_plain_http_hint: This address uses http://, so the ACL token would travel unencrypted. Allow it only on a trusted network, such as during development. Turn on TLS in Nomad to avoid it.
nomad_error_plain_http: This address uses plain HTTP. Allow sending the token over it, use https://, or choose No token.
nomad_error_no_leader: Nomad answered, but the cluster has no elected leader. Nothing was saved.
nomad_error_unreachable: Nomad could not be used: {detail}. Nothing was saved.
nomad_jobs_description: How device pages link to Nomad, and whether Hub shares the namespace.
nomad_ui_origin_hint: Optional. Its HTTPS address, such as https://nomad.site.example. Device pages then link to allocation logs, which open with the operator's own Nomad sign-in.
nomad_shared_writers: Other tools also change Hub's jobs
nomad_shared_writers_hint: Turn this on if another process may edit Hub's Nomad jobs directly. Hub then never purges a job, because a purge cannot check that the job is unchanged, so deployments cannot be deleted.
nomad_jobs_saved: Saved. New jobs and device pages use these values.
nomad_jobs_note: Saving does not change jobs that are already running.
nomad_error_ui_origin: Enter an HTTPS address without a path, such as https://nomad.site.example.
manager_description: Optional features of this manager, and the startup settings it was started with.
manager_features_description: Saved with the site settings; they apply at once.
manager_builds_hint: Lets administrators build drivers from the public repository. A build runs the driver's own Dockerfile on this manager's Docker daemon.
manager_builds_unavailable: The manager could not reach its Buildx builder at startup. Check the Compose buildkit service, then restart the manager.
manager_timings_hint: Adds a Server-Timing header to API responses with the request's duration and its Nomad calls. For diagnosing slow pages.
manager_error_builds_unavailable: This manager cannot build, so builds stay off.
manager_environment_description: Read from the manager's environment when it starts. They cannot be changed here.
manager_environment_how: To change one, set its variable where the manager is started and restart it. With the standard setup that is the environment section of compose.yaml.
manager_environment_error: Startup settings could not be loaded
env_DRIVER_HUB_DISTRIBUTION_ADDRESS: Address Nomad clients reach the manager at
api_tokens_description: Bearer tokens for scripts and automation. Each acts with its role, without signing in.
api_tokens_error_title: API tokens could not be loaded
api_tokens_empty_body: Scripts that call the Hub API need a token. Create one for each script, so each can be revoked on its own.
api_tokens_footnote: Hub keeps only a hash of each token. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
api_tokens_create_description: The token is shown once, right after it is created.
api_tokens_name_hint: What uses it, such as Monitoring or Nightly backup.
api_tokens_error_name_taken: A token with this name already exists.
api_tokens_created_body: This is the only time Hub shows it. Store it where the script reads its secrets.
api_tokens_delete_body: Scripts using this token are refused from now on. This cannot be undone.
api_tokens_emergency_title: The emergency administrator token is set
api_tokens_emergency_body: DRIVER_HUB_ADMIN_TOKEN in the manager's environment also gives administrator access. Unset it once API tokens are in place, unless you keep it for when every administrator is locked out.
videoipath_mode_per_device_description: Recommended. Each new device reserves its own pre-issued token and keeps it through restarts, updates and rollbacks.
videoipath_mode_shared_description: Every new deployment uses the same token, so revoking it affects all of them.
videoipath_pool_empty_body: Staging another device fails until you add a token. Create one in the VideoIPath CLI and add it below.
videoipath_current_note: Hub does not open a VideoIPath session to check this target. Drivers connect to it when they start.
videoipath_assignments_description: SHA-256 of each token, to match your issuance records
videoipath_form_description: Existing deployments keep the target they were staged with.
videoipath_address_hint: A host name, or a wss:// URL ending in /x-driver/v1.
videoipath_tokens_hint: Pre-issued external-driver tokens from the VideoIPath CLI, one per line. Saved tokens are never shown again.
videoipath_shared_hint: A pre-issued external-driver token from the VideoIPath CLI.
videoipath_shared_keep_hint: Leave empty to keep the saved token.
videoipath_new_pool_title: This starts a new token pool
videoipath_new_pool_body: A different address or token mode does not carry saved tokens over. Revoke tokens you no longer need in VideoIPath.
videoipath_submit_note: Saving does not open a driver session.
videoipath_saved_tokens: Saved. {count} token(s) added to the pool.
videoipath_error_address: Enter a host name, or a wss:// or https:// URL with no path other than /x-driver/v1.
videoipath_error_tokens_required: Add at least one token. Staging a device needs an unused one.
videoipath_error_token_long: A token is at most 8192 characters.
catalog_description: Published releases, retained releases and customer builds.
catalog_import_intro: Required: archive, driver ID and version.
catalog_import_id_tip: Stable catalog ID. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
catalog_import_name_tip: Catalog label. Defaults to the driver ID.
catalog_import_commit_tip: Source revision for reference. Use the full 40-character lowercase Git hash.
catalog_import_directory_tip: Driver folder in the source repository. For reference only.
catalog_import_archive_hint: One gzipped OCI image (.tar.gz), up to 2 GiB. Importing does not start it.
catalog_import_version_hint: Release version, e.g. 1.2.0. Use a new version for changed content.
catalog_import_config_hint: Declare driver inputs or a control health check. Blank means neither.
catalog_import_metadata_size: The release metadata exceeds the 256 KiB limit.
catalog_import_image_size: Choose a non-empty image archive no larger than 2 GiB.
catalog_import_conflict: A different release already uses this driver ID and version. Use a new version for changed content.
catalog_import_cancelled: Upload cancelled. If the Hub already finished verifying the image, retrying with the same file and metadata will return the retained release.
catalog_empty_published: No matching releases have been published. The upstream repository must publish a versioned driver release with a release manifest before it appears here.
catalog_empty_retained: No releases are stored on this Hub yet. An administrator can download a published release, import a local image, or build from source.
catalog_no_inputs: This driver declares no configuration inputs.
catalog_build_hint: Build a driver from a pinned revision of the VideoIPath external drivers repository. The resulting release is stored on this Hub.
catalog_commit_hint: Enter the full 40-character lowercase Git commit hash.
catalog_directory_hint: Path to the driver under Drivers/ or examples/ in that revision.
catalog_declaration_hint: Leave blank to use driver-config.json from the source directory.
catalog_invalid_json: Enter a JSON object with schemaVersion 1 and an inputs array.
catalog_build_off: Source builds are off on this manager. Published releases can still be downloaded. An administrator turns builds on in the Manager settings.
catalog_submitted: Request accepted for {driver}. See recent downloads and builds for the result.
catalog_saved: The release for {driver} is now stored on this Hub.
catalog_updates_no_cluster: Connect a Nomad cluster to check for updates to deployed drivers.
catalog_no_updates: No newer published versions were found for your deployments.
activity_description: Downloads and builds running in the background.
nomad_description: The cluster that runs this site's drivers.
videoipath_description: Where drivers connect, and the pool of pre-issued driver tokens.
users_description: Local operator accounts and their roles.
forbidden_body: Your account can view deployments but not site settings. Ask an administrator if you need access.
error_not_found_body: There is nothing at this address.
